auth.credentialsAtCorporativo: Your password and verification code are entered securely in corporativo.

rates.title: Rates and capacity
rates.subtitle: Manual effective-dated rates and purchased-capacity history
rates.proration: Daily actual/actual proration uses the monthly rate divided by the actual days in the month. Final-consumed rows are locked; corrections require a new non-overlapping effective period.
rates.provisionalNote: Provisional rates support rehearsal. Contracted rates and the real invoice are required for final financial acceptance.
rates.ratesTitle: Rates by organization and license type
rates.error: Unable to save. Check dates, overlaps and final-close locks, then retry.
rates.loadError: Unable to load rates and capacity. Please retry.
rates.forbidden: Central Finance or Group Admin access is required.

close.title: Monthly close
close.subtitle: Generate license statements for a completed month. Target: business day 3.
close.licenseOnly: License charges only: register seat-days × effective monthly rates, prorated daily using actual days in the month. Provisional rates are marked on license lines.
close.noRun: No close run for this period.
close.error: The close could not start. Check your access and input, then try again.
close.confirm: Existing drafts will be recalculated. Final statements stay unchanged. Missing rates fail the close without changing statements.
close.loadError: Could not load monthly close. Try again.
close.overTarget: Runtime target missed: 5 minutes or more

finalization.title: Finalize statements
finalization.immutable: Final statements are immutable. Record later adjustments as new lines on the next draft. Consumed rates are locked.
finalization.confirm: I confirm these drafts are ready to become immutable finals.
finalization.error: Could not finalize. Refresh and rerun close if rates changed, then try again.

reconciliation.title: Reconciliation by organization
reconciliation.subtitle: Compare finalized statement totals with the manually entered vendor invoice.
reconciliation.noInvoice: Enter the invoice amount to compare.
reconciliation.tolerance: Tolerance: 0.5% of the invoice total. Saving within tolerance automatically reconciles and freezes the evidence. Outside tolerance, explain the differences and approve an override with a mandatory note.
reconciliation.immutable: Reconciled and overridden evidence is immutable. Record corrections in the next period.
reconciliation.empty: No complete finalized organizations for this period. Finalize the company statements in Close first.
reconciliation.error: Unable to save. Check the inputs, access and reconciliation status, then retry.

statements.title: Statements
statements.subtitle: Monthly license charges by company
statements.empty: No statements match this period and filters.
statements.noRun: No visible close run for this period.
statements.failed: Close failed; the displayed statements remain from their stamped runs.
statements.scopeNote: Draft amounts may change on rerun. Final and reconciled statements retain their recorded status and amounts.
statements.evidenceNote: Movements identify register assignments and people; rates and seat-days come from generated license lines.
